import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Define features and target
target_col = "Cover_Type"
id_col = "Id"
train_feature_cols = [
    col for col in train_df.columns if col not in [id_col, target_col]
]
test_feature_cols = [col for col in test_df.columns if col != id_col]

# Verify column match
print(
    f"Train features: {len(train_feature_cols)}, Test features: {len(test_feature_cols)}"
)

# Extract features and target
X_train = train_df[train_feature_cols].values
y_train = train_df[target_col].values
X_test = test_df[test_feature_cols].values
test_ids = test_df[id_col].values

# Create proper train/validation split (80/20)
print("Creating train/validation split...")
np.random.seed(42)
n_samples = len(X_train)
indices = np.random.permutation(n_samples)
split_idx = int(0.8 * n_samples)

train_mask = indices[split_idx:]
val_mask = indices[:split_idx]

X_train_final = X_train[train_mask]
y_train_final = y_train[train_mask]
X_val_final = X_train[val_mask]
y_val_final = y_train[val_mask]

print(f"Training samples: {len(X_train_final)}, Validation samples: {len(X_val_final)}")

# Train LightGBM with optimized parameters for faster training
print("Training LightGBM Model...")
model = LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=100,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=31,
    max_depth=5,
    verbose=-1,
    random_state=42,
    force_col_wise=True,
)
model.fit(X_train_final, y_train_final)

# Validate on held-out data
print("Validating model...")
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val_final)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val_final, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.4f}")

# Predict on test set
print("Predicting on Test Set...")
y_test_pred = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission in correct format
print("Creating submission...")
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_ids, "Cover_Type": y_test_pred})
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission_df.shape}")
print(f"Expected rows: 400000, Actual rows: {len(submission_df)}")
